answer: Each identity deposits 90 POA into a shared kernel contract that unlocks only after 24 clean epochs, and must publish a fresh, key-bound timing-proof plume every epoch that any peer can replay. Standing up 800 fake names therefore requires 72,000 POA before any reward is reachable. Buying a relic account does not shortcut this: a transfer burns residual work credits and restarts the lock, so rented histories cannot harvest the pool.
